comment.body: Thanks for describing the Windows-key conflict. Current Grab and Move can capture and replay the Windows modifier when another key is pressed, so the exact Command Palette chord matters; the report is from 0.99.1. Could you share the current PowerToys version, the Grab and Move modifier setting, and whether the exact Command Palette shortcut still fails with Grab and Move enabled? No new logs are needed for this check.
